newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Sharon says peace requires concessions.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Sharon says peace requires concessions.

text.p: Israeli cabinet minister Ariel Sharon, a former general better known as a warrior than a peacemaker with the Arabs, said in remarks broadcast on Wednesday that peace required making concessions.

In remarks to potential investors in the United States broadcast by Israel Radio, Sharon said: "Peace, it's something hard, it's painful, sometimes painful like war. One must make concessions -- it's hard but it will happen".

Sharon, the 68-year-old minister of national infrastructure, did not elaborate. He was in New York to attend an Israel-North America Business conference intended to spark U.S. investment in Israeli infrastructure.

Sharon led Israel into its most unpopular war in Lebanon as defence minister in 1982 and fought the United States over a Jewish settlement boom of occupied Arab lands he implemented as housing minister in the 1990s.
